questions.question_english: A Head of School has mandated that all leave applications must be processed through the e-HRMS portal, thereby completely halting paper applications. What management objective does this fulfill?
options_english: Intentionally maximizing office paper procurement and physical archiving requirements
Deliberately delaying administrative leave approvals to discourage staff from taking leave
Ensuring transparency, creating audit trails, and speeding up approvals.
Unlawfully delegating the principal’s official statutory signing authority to clerical IT assistants
questions.explanation_english: Mandating electronic leave application processing through e-HRMS platforms enhances organizational transparency, establishes verifiable digital audit trails, and accelerates administrative approval workflows. questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। इलेक्ट्रॉनिक छुट्टी आवेदन प्रक्रिया को e-HRMS प्लेटफार्मों के माध्यम से अनिवार्य करना संगठनात्मक पारदर्शिता को बढ़ाता है, सत्यापन योग्य डिजिटल ऑडिट ट्रेल्स स्थापित करता है, और प्रशासनिक अनुमोदन कार्यप्रवाह को तेज करता है। स्वचालित रूटिंग भौतिक कागज के आंदोलन को समाप्त करती है, प्रसंस्करण में देरी को कम करती है, और कर्मचारियों और प्रशासकों को वास्तविक समय की स्थिति ट्रैकिंग प्रदान करती है, मानव संसाधन प्रबंधन को आधुनिक बनाते हुए सार्वजनिक संस्थानों में समान छुट्टी नियमों के अनुपालन को लागू करती है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Ensuring transparency, creating audit trails, and speeding up approvals.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Mandating electronic leave application processing through e-HRMS platforms enhances organizational transparency, establishes verifiable digital audit trails, and accelerates administrative approval workflows.

questions.question_english:
A Principal receives a report of a ransomware attack on the school’s local administrative server,
      which has encrypted all internal examination records. What should be the immediate first step in incident response?
options_english: Immediately pay the requested extortion ransom to the cyber attackers to avoid public data leak
Complete a full hard-drive format of all student personal devices connected to the school Wi-Fi network
Isolate the infected server from the local network and internet to stop spread

questions.explanation_english: Upon detecting a ransomware infection, the immediate administrative response is isolating the affected server from internal networks and internet connections to prevent lateral malware propagation. questions.question_english: Which of the following is regarded as the best practice for a school Principal in managing official passwords for institutional accounts (e.g., UDISE+, PFMS, Edudel)?
options_english: Writing credentials on a physical sticky note fixed directly to the office computer desktop monitor
Setting identical simple passwords based on the official school UDISE code to ensure easy staff recall
Sharing administrative credentials freely with the School Management Committee chairperson to foster openness
Using an encrypted password manager and strictly prohibiting credential sharing.
questions.explanation_english: Managing official administrative accounts securely requires storing access credentials within encrypted password managers and strictly prohibiting account sharing. Writing passwords on physical notes, using simple school-related combinations, or sharing administrative logins exposes sensitive systems like UDISE+ and PFMS to unauthorized access. Maintaining strict password hygiene preserves individual accountability and secures institutional databases from unauthorized access or breaches.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। आधिकारिक प्रशासनिक खातों का सुरक्षित प्रबंधन करने के लिए, क्रेडेंशियल को एन्क्रिप्टेड पासवर्ड प्रबंधकों में संग्रहीत करना और खाता साझा करने पर सख्ती से रोक लगाना आवश्यक है। भौतिक नोट्स पर पासवर्ड लिखना, सरल स्कूल-संबंधित संयोजनों का उपयोग करना, या प्रशासनिक लॉगिन साझा करना संवेदनशील प्रणालियों जैसे UDISE+ और PFMS को अनधिकृत पहुंच के लिए उजागर करता है। सख्त पासवर्ड स्वच्छता बनाए रखना व्यक्तिगत जिम्मेदारी को संरक्षित करता है और संस्थागत डेटाबेस को अनधिकृत पहुंच या उल्लंघनों से सुरक्षित रखता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Using an encrypted password manager and strictly prohibiting credential sharing.
